method: Era-Uniqueness 0-100: 1 - cosine(player, own-decade mean) in the L2-normalized MTNN v5 64-d embedding (assets/mtnn_embeddings.f32), minus the player's own season median (whole seasons drift together: rule changes, pace waves, the 2019-20 bubble), then min-max normalized to 0-100 over all 12,966 player-seasons. Higher = stranger for its time, relative to the player's own season baseline. Decade means are computed over the same normalized vectors.
